verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs clearly describe delegating tasks to built-in agents that plan, code, test, and demo work end-to-end while the user focuses on review/decisions, including background/parallel agents and always-on scheduled agents. This is a core, heavily documented capability of the product, though independent hands-on validation of agent task quality is thin (only general community commentary, some critical, exists). Missing for 10: deeper independent verification of agent task success rates beyond vendor docs.
